answer_result.answer: Yes. On 2023-08-03, Calvin said his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase. Later evidence also shows continued steps toward that goal, including networking to meet more artists and help build his fanbase, and after his tour he planned to explore and grow his brand.

question.question: Does Calvin want to expand his brand?

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-07-21, said he started making music to follow his dreams and is "stoked" about how far he's come [S11T10].
- On 2023-07-21, when Dave asked how he deals with the pressure and stays motivated: collaborating with others and learning from them keeps him motivated, and surrounding himself with positive energy and passion helps as well [S11T10].
- On 2023-08-03, said his plan for now (when Dave asked for his biggest goal) is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase — "I want my music to reach more people and make an impact" — and working with artists from around the globe and challenging himself to create special music are goals of his too (an extension of his earlier world-tour dream, see above) [S12T11].
- On 2023-08-03, shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02) — a photo of a band playing on stage with lights on — "they are great at the music!" [S12T11].
- On 2023-08-14, when Dave asked for pictures from the show, shared a photo from the tour's closing show in Tokyo (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)): a crowd of people at the concert with their hands up — "It was so awesome - I loved how the crowd was into it. These moments are why I love my job." [S14T8].

- On 2023-10-25, when Dave asked what got him into engineering cars, Calvin said he's "totally into cars too and love[s] making new and powerful models" (his own interest in making cars — complements the orange car project he relaxes on, see above, and his finding that working on cars relaxes him "like meditation"); seeing Dave work on cars is "inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music" (his love of cars also noted in the 2023-10-25 entry of ## Relationships) [S26T5].
- On 2023-10-25, shared a photo of himself performing at a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table in a nightclub) with someone he admires — "So amazing!" (Dave: "You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?") (Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S26T7][S26T8]. Calvin: performing "with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (complements his long-stated "fuels my soul"/concerts-are-what-he-lives-for remarks above; closing exchange details in the 2023-10-25 entry of ## Relationships) [S26T9].
- On 2023-10-29, told Dave that since they last talked he went to a networking event to meet more artists — "so cool!" — and that the people he met will help him build up his fan base — "super excited about what it could lead to." (an active step in his plan to expand his brand and grow his fanbase — see the 2023-08-03 entry above; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S27T1].
- On 2023-10-29, when Dave asked for music updates ("How's everything with the music? Any updates?"): Calvin said he'd had some great collaborations recently ("I've had some great collaborations recently") and his album is almost finished ("my album is almost finished") — a follow-up to the album that dropped 2023-09-11 (see above) — and promised he'll send Dave some previews soon ("I'll send you some previews soon"; Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it.") [S27T10][S27T11][S27T12].
- On 2023-11-02, told Dave that last week (~2023-10-26) he threw a small party at his Japanese mansion (see ## New home (2023-03-23)) for his new album — "It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends!" (the 2023-10-29 update above had his album at "almost finished") — and shared photos of the party: a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen ("Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!"), a group of people dancing at the party, and a group of people standing on top of a stage [S28T1][S28T3][S28T5].

- On 2023-08-03, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see!"): Calvin told him his recent Ferrari service was so stressful (he's attached to the car) and asked what kind of hobbies give Dave a feeling of being restored; Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for him — growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing gives fulfillment — and shared his fond childhood memory of spending a summer with his dad restoring an old car (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S12T1][S12T2][S12T4].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave shared a childhood photo of himself and his dad (a man and a child posing) from that car-restoring summer, and Calvin found it cool ("Reminiscing is always fun!"); Calvin then shared a photo of his red Ferrari on a lift in a garage, saying his car is the best and "reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; Dave said the car looks great, "I can tell why you're proud," and "it's like a reminder of what you can achieve" (details of Calvin's car in /memories/calvin.md > ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S12T5][S12T6][S12T7][S12T8].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave asked what Calvin's biggest goal is (music-wise or something else); Calvin said his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase, and that working with artists from around the globe and challenging himself to create special music are goals of his too, and he shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02) — a band playing on stage with lights on. Dave: "Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!" The conversation closed with Dave telling Calvin to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and to "stay focused and keep going... You've got this!", and Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" (Calvin's goal details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S12T10][S12T11][S12T12][S12T13][S12T14][S12T15][S12T16].
- On 2023-07-21, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we spoke!"): told him about his recent road trip with friends and shared a photo of a motorcycle on a dirt road (details in ## Road trip (2023-07-21)); Calvin told him about the recording-studio project in his Japanese mansion and shared a progress photo, and Dave marveled at the progress, said it must be very fulfilling to have his own space, and asked about the challenges of Calvin experimenting with genres and moving between styles (details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) [S11T1][S11T3][S11T4][S11T5][S11T7].
- The 2023-07-21 conversation continued: Dave asked how Calvin deals with the pressure of his music and stays motivated; Calvin said collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy helps; Dave encouraged him — surrounding himself with good vibes and collaborating "will give you a boost", "You've achieved so much so far; keep going, buddy!" (Calvin's motivation details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S11T9][S11T10][S11T11].

- On 2023-07-21, caught up with Dave ("been ages since we spoke!"): Dave told him he'd just returned from a road trip with friends (details in /memories/dave.md) and asked what Calvin had been up to; Calvin told him about the recording-studio project in the Japanese mansion, shared a progress photo, said he's been experimenting with electronic elements, and discussed the challenge of balancing his signature sound with new styles (details in ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) [S11T1][S11T4][S11T6][S11T8].
- The 2023-07-21 conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" — and saying he's gonna keep pushing himself and striving for his goals; Dave replied "You got this! ... I'm your biggest fan. Let's chat soon!", and Calvin signed off "Appreciate your support. Let's catch up soon and chat. Take care!" (Dave's side of the exchange in /memories/dave.md > ## Relationships) [S11T12][S11T13][S11T14].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave asked what Calvin's biggest goal is (music-wise or otherwise); Calvin named his plan for now (expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase — details in ## Music) and shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02), saying they are "great at the music". The conversation closed with mutual encouragement — Calvin: Dave's support and encouragement "mean a lot to me", he's "determined to make my dreams come true" and will "keep going for my dreams"; Dave: "Keep it up and keep making a difference!", "Keep at it and never forget your dreams!", "stay focused and keep going... You've got this!" [S12T10][S12T11][S12T12][S12T13][S12T14][S12T15][S12T16]. Calvin thanked Dave and signed off: "Thanks, Dave! I'll stay focused and keep going. Appreciate your belief!" [S12T17].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation continued: Calvin praised Dave's attention to detail on the car mod project — "You've really put in some work! That attention to detail is great" — agreed the small details are what make a masterpiece unique and personalized, and told Dave his "enthusiasm and hard work show in everything you do", encouraging him to "keep coming up with new cool stuff, bud" and saying he's excited to see what Dave will do next (Dave's car project details in /memories/dave.md > ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) [S13T10][S13T12][S13T14]. Dave offered Calvin a hand with his music stuff — his music studio has a high-quality sound system (details in the Music section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin thanked him, said he's "super busy with my music stuff at the moment" and will keep the offer in mind, and closed "Great work, dude!" [S13T15][S13T16].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation ended with Dave wishing Calvin good luck with his music, Calvin thanking Dave for the encouragement and saying he'll keep working hard and making music, and the two signing off ("Take care!" / "See ya, Calvin! Stay awesome. Catch ya later.") [S13T17][S13T18][S13T19].

- On 2023-09-13, told Dave his album finally dropped on 2023-09-11 ("the 11th" as of 2023-09-13) — it was "a wild feeling"; everyone's been loving it, and it's motivated him to keep going [S18T1].
- On 2023-09-13, said it's been a lot: it's "kinda overwhelming to think so many appreciate it", but it's cool that it's connecting with people, and it really motivates him to make even better music; moments like this remind him why he got into music — making a difference and sharing his own story — and the positive feedback gives him strength to keep going and reach more people: "My journey's just getting started!" [S18T3][S18T5].
- On 2023-09-13, said what's next is a tour ("Next up, a tour - so excited!"), and after that he's off to explore and grow his brand — "Can't wait to see what the future has in store!" (Dave asked about cities or venues, but Calvin did not answer in this exchange) [S18T7][S18T8].
- On 2023-09-13, got excited about the upcoming tour: "Yay! Dave! We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!" [S18T9].
- On 2023-09-15, reacted to Dave's update that the night before (2023-09-14) he and his band had been jamming: "When everything just clicks during a jam session, it's such a great feeling." He asked if Dave had recordings of the sessions, and when Dave said no ("way too into it and totally forgot"), said "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," adding that "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds." Dave also told him he attended a rock concert in Boston last weekend (~2023-09-09/10) with an "amazing atmosphere" (photo of a band on stage with bright lights); Calvin: "Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere!" (Dave's details in the Rock band and Music sections of /memories/dave.md) [S19T1][S19T2][S19T3][S19T4].

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, re-pledged the plan to let Dave know when he's in Boston — "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston" — and accepted Dave's offer to check out his garage and its cool cars (Dave shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), saying it would be fun and might give him ideas for future projects (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S18T11][S18T12].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- Has been experimenting with different genres lately, pushing himself out of his comfort zone — adding electronic elements to his songs gives them "a fresh vibe"; he calls it "an exciting process of self-discovery and growth" [S11T6].
- Finds switching between styles challenging — "it's a matter of finding the right balance between sticking to [his] sound and trying new stuff"; "it can be intimidating, but that's what makes it so exciting and keeps [him] motivated to keep going!" [S11T8].
- On 2023-11-02, said the connection music creates with people is "that connection I'm aiming for with my music" (his goal for his music; complements his 2023-10-25 "passion and purpose" remark — see ## Music) [S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, shared a photo of the studio setup (a recording studio with a monitor, keyboard, and monitor) — Calvin: "Take a loot at my studio setup, that's look awesome, isn't it?"; Dave: "Wow, your studio looks stunning!" [S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked how he likes hanging out there and whether he watches much TV: he only works in the studio; he has a separate room for relaxation with a TV (photo of a living room with a couch, chair, television and a table — "that room is cozy and relaxing"), which is "a great way to unwind and get inspired" [S28T29].
